supply_overlay.scope: Candidate to reduce measured local supply losses through physical M4-to-M6 risers in sixteen macros. Horizontal shunt via X offsets are4um for samplers and12um for other leaves to avoid opposite-rail riser crossings. Does not bypass any wire model or intrinsic device. Native fresh extraction and loaded gate remeasurement required. New XOR children have Metal5 ports and receive actual supply shunts and risers.
